title: BehaviorSpec
description: Typed behavior sublanguage carried inside DesignSpec.goal / DesignSpec.objectives. Compiled from natural language; serializable, editable and testable. Extended 2026-06-03 with the behavior-language axes (substrate / behavior_family / arity / input_domain / output_semantics / evidence_backend + logic and analog-surface blocks) for the move from the SISO Bandpass MVP to a modular behavior design language; the extension is additive — Suite-A dose-shape specs (behavior_family=dose_shape, behavior_class + shape_preferences) remain valid unchanged. NOTE: hand-authored; to be wired into webapp/scripts/gen_schemas.jl (struct-generated) so the CI drift-guard covers it.
$comment: This is the AUTHORED / NL-facing NESTED form. It is intentionally DIFFERENT from the FLAT `behavior_spec` block in the benchmark task JSONs (benchmarks/tasks/*.json), which is a LOWERED verifier query (flat shape-gate keys like rise_slope_max / fall_slope_min / plateau_width_log10_input_min) consumed by run_benchmark.jl / design_search.py. They share a name but not a schema. Per-family lowering (dose_shape -> flat gates; logic -> truth-table query; analog -> surface-match query) is the evaluator-registry dispatch; only dose_shape lowering exists today. behavior_class is required only for behavior_family=dose_shape (enforced by the DoseShapeEvaluator, not by this schema's required list, to stay within the dependency-free validator's draft-07 subset).

substrate.description: Physical substrate / evidence backend family. The committed substrate is equilibrium binding / competitive dimerization; others are declared-but-deferred (the compiler must not silently route a request to an unsupported substrate).

behavior_family.description: Top-level behavior family selecting the evaluator. Only the first four are supported by the current equilibrium backend; the rest are declared-but-unsupported.

inputs.description: Input total symbols for multi-input families (e.g. ["tA","tB"]). For one-input dose_shape the single swept axis is given by input_axis instead.

behavior_class.description: dose_shape (Suite A) vocabulary-v0 class. Required when behavior_family=dose_shape. 'bandpass_like' is a user-language alias resolved by the compiler.

input_axis.description: Swept axis for one-input dose_shape. 'plateau'/'range' refer to width along this log axis, NOT real-time duration.

logic.description: Suite-B logic target (behavior_family=logic). The LogicTruthTableEvaluator returns a truth-table-agreement score and on/off margins.

analog.description: Suite-C analog response-surface target (behavior_family=analog_surface). The AnalogSurfaceEvaluator scores the 2D output heatmap against the target.

shape_preferences.description: Soft preferences / numeric gates on per-curve metrics (names match the phenotyper output fields). dose_shape only.

min_robustness_score.description: Lower bound on shape_support (the distributional robustness number) under the declared phenotyper_version.

compilation_notes.description: Per-phrase notes recording how ambiguous language was interpreted (e.g. whether 'longer plateau' meant plateau_width_log10_input vs real time).

booleanization.description: Maps continuous output (log10 of the output species/observable) to high/low for truth-table scoring.

kd_profile.description: Coarse Kd language compiled to explicit numeric/relative constraints (Kd-semantics section).

scale_ref.description: Concentration/total-input scale a relative bin is defined against.
